The '''Sullust Sector Spacefarers Academy''' was a [[pilot]]ing academy located on the [[planet]] [[Sullust]]. Most graduates of the academy took positions as commercial pilots, joined navies in local [[star system]]s, or joined the [[Galactic Republic]] [[Judicial Department]]. [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] attended the academy after working with the [[Outland Regions Security Force]]. [[Nils Tenant]] attended the academy during his [[Youngling|youth]].<ref name="Tarkin" />
